style: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a medieval valley tile-laying game, green fields, stone towers and vines, warm afternoon light, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark brown outline, simple readable silhouette, no text
notes: Pose / expression set. One character = one reused description + the reference painting (meta.ref) + the same seed, same camera, same scale, centred, feet on one baseline. Background is flat chroma colour (meta.bg) so games-src/scripts/cutout.py can key it: save each as <name>.png in one folder per character, then python3 games-src/scripts/cutout.py <folder>/<char>-*.png --out <target folder> --size 512 --align <meta.align>  (writes transparent webp + contact-sheet.png). Check the contact sheet: all poses the same height, same feet line. Style block: use the one in "style" but ignore any background wording in it. Painted variety. Ratio and size are in meta; paint at 1024 px or larger on the long side, we crop and convert. Tables and boards: calm empty middle for the game. Style block: the one in "style". Items with meta.bg set are cut-outs on a flat chroma colour for cutout.py.
